name: review_my_recent_activity
description: Station B, B1 (flaw). Same scope and read rules as B2 (the Station A2 read rules), but it takes a backend accountId and returns the raw transaction rows (txnIds, and raw account IDs as counterparties for transfers). Memos pass through unchanged, as in B2.

input.description: Calls GET /accounts/{accountId}/transactions on the Dewy Bank customer API and returns the rows from the transactions table (txnId, accountId, type, amount, counterparty, memo, category, createdAt), newest first. Use this when the customer asks what has happened in an account, about a payment, or why a balance changed. Get the accountId from list_my_accounts first. Optionally say how many entries to show. Returns the HTTP status code and, on an error, the customer API's error message.
